summary: Tested new e-invoicing (facturation électronique — mode simulé/mocked) feature end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed covering pro_required gating (particulier 403), status, connect (valid + invalid SIRET 400), inbox seed, simulate reception (400 when disconnected), decision accept/refuse (with admin_status='transmis (simulé)'), invalid decision 400, unknown inv_id 404, disconnect. Frontend: Pro login -> /factures shows einvoicing-banner -> click navigates to /factures-electroniques -> connected bar shown (Pro was already seeded) -> simulate adds 1 row (5->6) -> accept dialog + confirm updates row to einv-status-accepted -> refuse confirm is correctly disabled without reason, enabled with reason, updates row to einv-status-refused. All data-testids verified.
critical_code_review_comments: einvoicing.py: correctly excludes _id via projection {'_id': 0} on find/find_one — good. simulate_reception also pops _id after insert_one — good.
connect endpoint idempotent via upsert — good. SIRET normalised (digits only) before validating length 14 — robust.
pro_required is correctly enforced both at router-level dependencies and per-endpoint Depends (double-guarded). Fine, no duplication issue.
Frontend EInvoicing.jsx correctly disables confirm button when decision='refused' and reason is empty; UX is aligned with backend which stores reason[:300].
